ideas.pitch: An anti-money laundering risk detection and investigation platform tailored for emerging financial transactions, integrating graph intelligence with simulated quantum key distribution audit logs.
ideas.title: QuantumRisk-AML: Graph-Based Quantum-Resistant Transaction Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the club's focus on quantum technology and emerging paradigms, mirroring the Bito AML risk detection win by combining graph intelligence with high-demand financial security use cases.

ideas.pitch: A forecasting tool using Poisson regression and statistical backtesting to predict quantum processor gate fidelity degradation and qubit decoherence spikes over rolling windows.
ideas.title: Q-Forecast: Calibrated Prediction Intervals for Quantum Hardware Error Rates
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a technical problem familiar to organizers from Q-Bits (the quantum club hosting the event), directly applying statistical forecasting techniques that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform designed to audit campus land use, solar panel efficiency, and green cover compliance for large university grounds.
ideas.title: EcoAero-Campus: Satellite Monitoring for Institutional Carbon Footprints
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages satellite monitoring patterns that won regional hackathons, giving university organizers a direct tool to showcase sustainability on their own campus.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow payments on Base, built to streamline micro-grants and resource sharing for student-led quantum and AI research projects.
ideas.title: Decentralized-Campus-Credit: USDC Escrow for Student Research Grants
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements autonomous agent workflows and escrow rails that successfully won the Synthesis Hackathon, fitting the event's tech innovator profile.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine customized for institutional medical clinics, automating intake triage, appointment matching, and secure health record summaries.
ideas.title: MedTrust-AI: Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine for University Hospitals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets real healthcare operational friction experienced by institutional medical setups, replicating the exact strategy of the 1st Prize Elevate X win.
